name: Labyrinth
description: A marble maze game for Android, built in Flutter with Box2D physics by a team of five that I led. Levels are drawn in Inkscape and converted to physics geometry automatically.
highlights: Led a five-person team: broke the project into tasks on a RACI chart (who is Responsible, Accountable, Consulted and Informed) and tracked each one to its deadline
Set up the app structure the team built on
Wrote svg2level.py, turning Inkscape drawings into JSON levels whose curved walls become exact Forge2D edge colliders

media.caption: The final release build running on an Android emulator: title screen, level select, then a full run of Level 1 (gameplay sped up 2×). "Jolly Fox" is the game's placeholder name for an offline player, not a real person
Level 1, drawn in Inkscape by Daniel Hinbest and converted by svg2level.py, rendered here from its .level file
The RACI chart I used to assign and track the team's tasks
